svg.title: 02 | Order lifetime changes the trade population
svg.desc: EBP-PY-H002 · XAUUSD2 H4 · 2020-01-01 to 2026-08-01 exclusive · historical revalidation GTC keeps one pending order until filled or cancelled; replacement supersedes it only when active-position eligibility permits. Neither has a time expiry. The second ambiguity is post-entry break-even confirmation: completed H4 versus intrabar extreme. Common execution corrections apply to all arms. All four arms PARK; overall AMBIGUITY_SENSITIVE. Executable-side price R is not fully cost-qualified net profit. No winner selected. Source B21.
